# Systems, passes and services

Hand-written docs, one per system. Kinds: `system` (a `dy::System` in a `SystemSet` lane), `pass` (renderer scene pass), `service` (other code that reads or writes registry state).

| System | Kind | Registry name | Scope | Lane | Folder | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BoxDropSys](BoxDropSys.md) | system | BoxDrop | World | Fixed (Every) | `src/logic/systems` | init only: creates `count` box (or capsule) RigidBody entities on a jittered centered grid above the ground with the world RNG; tick is a no-op. |
| [BoxRingSys](BoxRingSys.md) | system | BoxRing | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | At init drops a ring of 12 dynamic boxes above the terrain around the origin (base scene). |
| [BoxThrowerSys](BoxThrowerSys.md) | system | BoxThrower | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | Left click (not captured by ImGui) throws a 1 m dynamic box from the desktop camera. |
| [Capture](Capture.md) | service | — | n/a | per-frame call from Game::start | `src/view` | Capture script runner: injects scripted SDL input, moves the desktop Camera per shot, waits for terrain and writes PNGs. |
| [ChunkGeneratorSys](ChunkGeneratorSys.md) | system | ChunkGenerator | Host | Pre | `src/logic/systems` | Generates chunk densities with TerrainGenerator on the taskflow executor (at most 16 jobs, nearest first; all at once and synchronously in deterministic runs) and tags the results. |
| [ChunkManagerSys](ChunkManagerSys.md) | system | ChunkManager | Host | Pre | `src/logic/systems` | Creates ChunkC entities within view_distance of the desktop Camera and the VR rig, tags chunks beyond view_distance + one chunk with ChunkDestroying. |
| [ClassicRender](ClassicRender.md) | service | — | n/a | per-frame call from Renderer::prepare / Renderer::render | `src/renderer/classic_render` | Desktop render target: acquires the swapchain image unless the window is hidden, writes the ViewUBO from the Camera, records the passes, presents, optional frame capture. |
| [DebugMenuSys](DebugMenuSys.md) | system | DebugMenu | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | ImGui 'Dynamical' window: frame time, camera, chunk counts, render toggles, physics stats, grass parameters, VR state. |
| [FixedCameraSys](FixedCameraSys.md) | system | FixedCamera | Host | Pre | `src/view` | Places the desktop Camera once at init from JSON pos / look_at. |
| [Game](Game.md) | service | — | n/a | per-frame loop owner (called from main) | `src/view` | Owns the host registry, emplaces Settings/tf::Executor/RunArgs/FrameClock/Worlds, builds renderer and SystemSet from the scene, runs the frame loop. |
| [GrassPass](GrassPass.md) | pass | — | n/a | per-frame call from Renderer::render (record on a taskflow worker, once per render target) | `src/renderer/passes` | Redraws the chunk meshes lifted by the grass height with the raymarched grass shader, parameters from RenderSettings::grass_params. |
| [InputSys](InputSys.md) | system | Input | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | Emplaces the Input context variable and fills it each frame from the SDL event queue and window state. |
| [ModelLineupSys](ModelLineupSys.md) | system | ModelLineup | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | At init lines up every glTF file of resources/models (except box.gltf) as a dynamic box-collider model (base scene). |
| [ModelManager](ModelManager.md) | service | — | n/a | on demand (called by systems and the ModelRenderable scene component) | `src/renderer/model` | Context variable that loads a glTF file (or a code-built MeshData) once, creates one entity holding its ModelC and caches it by path/key. |
| [ModelPass](ModelPass.md) | pass | — | n/a | per-frame call from Renderer::render (update on main thread, record on a taskflow worker) | `src/renderer/passes` | Creates material descriptor sets of new ModelC entries, then draws every Transform + ModelRenderable entity with the ModelC it points to. |
| [ModelWatcherSys](ModelWatcherSys.md) | system | ModelWatcher | Host | Pre | `src/onnx` | Viewer host system: loads ONNX policies (fixed files or the newest checkpoint of a directory, hot-reloaded) and injects them as PolicyHandle into each world, reporting in PolicySources. |
| [PhysicsStepSys](PhysicsStepSys.md) | system | PhysicsStep | World | Fixed (Every) | `src/physics` | One fixed tick of a world: kinematic targets, PhysicsConfig::substeps Jolt updates of h / substeps, then PhysicsPose and Transform of dynamic bodies. |
| [PhysicsSys](PhysicsSys.md) | system | Physics | Host | Pre | `src/physics` | Host Jolt step: fixed 60 Hz accumulator (FixedStepClock), kinematic bodies follow Transforms, dynamic Transforms interpolated from PhysicsPose, fallen entities destroyed. |
| [PlayerControlSys](PlayerControlSys.md) | system | PlayerControl | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | Emplaces the desktop Camera and flies it with WASD/Space/Ctrl and right-mouse look; R moves the VR play area under it. |
| [PolicySys](PolicySys.md) | system | Policy | World | Fixed (Act) | `src/onnx` | Runs the world's PolicyHandle ONNX policy on AgentIO::observation and writes AgentIO::action for the decision window. |
| [Probe](Probe.md) | service | — | Host | per-frame call from Game::start, after post_tick | `src/scene` | Behaviour probe: every probe_every frames writes one CSV row (frame, rank, entity, position, rotation) per host entity holding Transform (and RigidBody). |
| [Renderer](Renderer.md) | service | — | n/a | per-frame call from Game::start (prepare before systems, render after them) | `src/renderer` | Owns the Vulkan/OpenXR Context, both render targets and the scene passes; emplaces ModelManager, RenderSettings and Context*; per frame waits the fence, chains transfer -> compute -> graphics and records both targets in parallel. |
| [RigidBodySys](RigidBodySys.md) | system | RigidBody | Both | Pre (host scenes) / Fixed (Every) (world templates) | `src/physics` | Creates the Jolt bodies of new RigidBody, Ground and HeightField components and destroys them when the component or entity goes away. |
| [RollerPlayerSys](RollerPlayerSys.md) | system | VRRoller / DesktopRoller | Host | Pre | `src/view` | Turns VR (stick or lean) or desktop (WASD) input into a steerSphere command for one world's sphere and puts the play area / camera on it. |
| [ScenarioRunner](ScenarioRunner.md) | service | — | n/a | called by TrainHost / WorldsEnvironment and tests | `src/scene` | Headless scene driver: loads a scene, creates, preinits and inits its worlds, steps them and can restart them with another base seed. |
| [SceneLoader](SceneLoader.md) | service | — | n/a | one-shot call (loadScene) from Game::start, ScenarioRunner, tests | `src/scene` | Loads a .scene.json with includes, variables, file references, prefabs and world templates into a SceneDef; validates every entity by emplacing its components in a scratch registry. |
| [SphereControlSys](SphereControlSys.md) | system | SphereControl | World | Fixed (Every) | `src/logic/agents` | Before PhysicsStep: on the first tick of a decision window runs the pending episode reset and converts AgentIO::action into a world torque; every tick applies the held torque to the sphere's Jolt body. |
| [SphereHeuristicSys](SphereHeuristicSys.md) | system | SphereHeuristic | World | Fixed (Act) | `src/logic/agents` | Act phase: writes sphereHeuristic(observation) (gain 1) into AgentIO::action when the observation has 16 floats. |
| [SphereObserveSys](SphereObserveSys.md) | system | SphereObserve | World | Fixed (Observe) | `src/logic/agents` | Observe phase: handles a host RESET or publishes the window's reward / done / stats into AgentIO, then writes the 16-float observation of the live target. |
| [SphereTaskSys](SphereTaskSys.md) | system | SphereTask | World | Fixed (Every) | `src/logic/agents` | After PhysicsStep: accumulates the per-tick reward against the decision target, drifts the live target toward its goal, ends and parks the episode when out of bounds or fallen. |
| [SphereViewSys](SphereViewSys.md) | system | SphereView | Host | Pre | `src/view` | Follow camera, velocity bars, rotation dots and an ImGui panel for one world's SphereAgent. |
| [SystemSet](SystemSet.md) | service | — | n/a | owns the Pre / Post / Fixed lanes; fixed_tick called by World::tick | `src/logic/systems` | Ordered lists of systems (Pre, Post, Fixed lanes); fixed_tick gates Every/Act systems on the world's Parked flag and runs Act/Observe systems on the first/last tick of the decision window. |
| [TerrainCollidersSys](TerrainCollidersSys.md) | system | TerrainColliders | Host | Pre | `src/physics` | Builds static marching-cubes MeshShape colliders around the host's dynamic bodies before this frame's physics steps, prefetches cells on their path. |
| [TerrainPass](TerrainPass.md) | pass | — | n/a | per-frame call from Renderer::render (record on a taskflow worker, once per render target) | `src/renderer/passes` | Draws every ChunkGPU + ChunkReady chunk with an indirect draw, triplanar grass/rock texturing. |
| [TerrainSys](TerrainSys.md) | system | Terrain | Host | Post | `src/renderer/terrain` | Records marching cubes compute dispatches for up to 8 pending chunks per frame, owns the per-slot GPU vertex buffers and indirect draw commands, and destroys chunk entities marked ChunkDestroying. |
| [TimeSys](TimeSys.md) | system | Time | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | Legacy in-game calendar clock (Time context variable) with pause key, speed radio buttons and a frame-time window. |
| [TrainerActionsSys](TrainerActionsSys.md) | system | TrainerActions | World | Fixed (Act) | `src/logic/agents` | Empty Act-phase placeholder of training templates: the training host writes AgentIO::action directly; scenes replace it with Policy or SphereHeuristic. |
| [TrainHost](TrainHost.md) | service | — | n/a | main loop of dynamical_train (TrainHost::run from train_main.cpp) | `src/train` | dynamical_train's loop: mode bench/null/train, environment parameters, ML-Agents handshake and RESET/STEP/QUIT serving against a TrainerEnvironment. |
| [UIPass](UIPass.md) | pass | — | n/a | per-frame call from Renderer::render (update on main thread, record on a taskflow worker, desktop only) | `src/renderer/passes` | Calls ImGui::Render, copies the draw lists into per-frame mapped buffers and draws them on the desktop target; touches no registry state. |
| [UISys](UISys.md) | system | UI | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | Feeds Input into ImGui's IO, starts the ImGui frame and masks mouse clicks ImGui captured. |
| [VRActions](VRActions.md) | service | — | n/a | per-frame call from VRRender::prepare (after xrBeginFrame) | `src/renderer/vr_render` | Emplaces VRInput and, every VR frame, writes head pose and per-hand controller state (pose, velocity, trigger, grip, thumbstick, primary button with rising edges) into it. |
| [VRControlSys](VRControlSys.md) | system | VRControl | Host | Pre | `src/view/systems` | VR stick locomotion and turning of the VRRig, right-trigger box throwing, and kinematic controller boxes following the hands. |
| [VRRender](VRRender.md) | service | — | n/a | per-frame call from Renderer::prepare / Renderer::render | `src/renderer/vr_render` | Headset render target: emplaces VRRig, polls OpenXR session events into VRInput, runs xrWaitFrame/xrBeginFrame/xrEndFrame, writes per-eye ViewUBOs from VRRig and located views. |
| [World](World.md) | service | — | World | per-frame call from Worlds::step (WorldStepperSys in dynamical, ScenarioRunner::step headless) | `src/scene` | One independent simulation: owns its registry, PhysicsWorld, WorldClock, WorldRng, WorldInfo and fixed-lane SystemSet; creates the template's entities and runs one fixed tick with the Act/Observe phases. |
| [Worlds](Worlds.md) | service | — | Host | per-frame call from WorldStepperSys (dynamical) / ScenarioRunner::step | `src/scene` | The worlds of a scene in index order (host context variable in dynamical); creates them with per-index seeds and steps them, in parallel on taskflow when given an executor. |

| [WorldStepperSys](WorldStepperSys.md) | system | WorldStepper | Host | Pre | `src/view` | Steps the scene's Worlds in real time from the frame dt (fixed-step accumulator, max 8 ticks a frame) with a pause/step panel. |
| [WorldTerrainSys](WorldTerrainSys.md) | system | WorldTerrain | World | Fixed (Every) | `src/physics` | Per-world marching-cubes ground: builds TerrainColliders cells inline around every dynamic body before the world's PhysicsStep. |
